name: object-based-ilp-1d-arc — Cloud Agent VPS: 4×Xeon vCPU, 15GiB RAM, 0 swap, ~252G disk, Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 (KVM)
install:
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
sudo apt-get update -qq
sudo apt-get install -y -qq software-properties-common python3.12-venv python3-venv python3-dev build-essential parallel gringo
sudo add-apt-repository -y ppa:swi-prolog/stable
sudo apt-get update -qq
sudo apt-get install -y -qq swi-prolog
rm -rf .venv
python3 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip
.venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
.venv/bin/pip install -e ./popper
.venv/bin/pip install pytest
